## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

# OMG (Oh My GitHub) agent instructions

Do not implement, suggest, report, or propose security issues unless the user explicitly asks for a security review.
Inspect the OpenCode implementation at `/Users/igor/Documents/ChatGPT/opencode` and [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) for related requests.

## Wiki index

- [OpenCode workflow](wiki/opencode.md)
- [Test OpenCode execution](wiki/opencode-v2-experiment.md)
- [Oh My Github App](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/oh-my-github-app.md)
- [Temporary Mac SSH access](wiki/access.md)
- [Testing and verification](wiki/testing.md)
- [OmGithub publishing](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/omgithub.md)


## Main project file

The main project file is [.github/workflows/opencode.yml](.github/workflows/opencode.yml).

Keep the local [game issue E2E skill](.agents/skills/game-issue-e2e/SKILL.md)
aligned with this workflow. Create an issue with `OpenCode` and only user-requested mode labels already attached, to start the native `issues.opened` listener. Wait only for the
initial OpenCode session link during E2E kickoff. Install the listener on the
default branch before requesting execution. Validate author access and freeze
the request inside Actions before starting the reusable execution job.
Set repository variable `OPENCODE_ACCESS=everyone` to accept any issue author
for labeled issues. Keep the App as a setup
helper. Use Actions concurrency to serialize each issue.
Store `branch` in an `omgithub-request:v1` JSON HTML comment to select the
project checkout, result base, and workflow. Let default-branch preparation
dispatch the selected branch. Run preparation and OpenCode in that branch run.

## Shell timing

When writing shell scripts,
always add explicit per-command execution-time measurements between commands.
Use `/usr/bin/time -p` or a small timing helper around each meaningful command;
the outer command duration is not sufficient because it hides which step is
slow or hung. Use `/usr/bin/time` only in scripts; do not invoke it directly in
interactive shell commands.

## Ideas

Store durable implementation ideas as individual Markdown files under
`./ideas/`, using descriptive kebab-case filenames such as
`ideas/opencode-oauth-env-auth.md`.




## Links in handoffs

When a relevant URL or stable identifier exists, include a clickable Markdown
link in the user-facing response. Link GitHub issues, Actions runs, pull
requests, commits, releases, public app URLs, and Codex tasks/threads rather
than reporting only their numbers or plain text. For Codex tasks/threads, use
the `codex://threads/<thread-id>` URL format.

When mentioning a commit, append its relative age in hours or days.

## OpenCode GitHub Actions

To execute an issue, create it with `OpenCode` and only mode labels explicitly requested by the user.
Check for a native `issues` run and successful preparation.
The workflow starts a temporary AgentsWeb SSH session,
verifies it, runs OpenCode, and cleans up the SSH session afterward.

When monitoring a triggered run, use `gh run watch <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --exit-status` for overall job status.
Do not use `gh run view --log` to read logs from a running task: GitHub reports that
logs are unavailable until completion. Use `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>`
for the live Actions log over SSH. Do not use tight `for` loops around `gh run list`,
which needlessly consume GitHub API rate limit.

Free OpenCode models are limited per egress IP, not per account.
Treat a local `FreeUsageLimitError` 429 as local only.
Read the runner's own `Selected model` and provider errors before blaming quota.
Use `retryAfterMs` as the reset bound.
Run repeated V2 tests with a connected provider; do not spend the free allowance on retries.

Interrupting a V2 turn before the assistant message projects leaves no stopped message to save.
Wait for that assistant message before requiring the interrupted idle marker.

To connect to an issue's live worker, find its run ID with
`gh run list --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --workflow opencode.yml --status in_progress`,
then run `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>` to discover the host and port and SSH
with `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb` as shown by the helper.

When the user asks to check a live OpenCode workflow, always pull the runner logs
over SSH first, using `scripts/ssh-run-log.sh` or a targeted SSH read from the
same runner. Base the answer on those logs before discussing whether an action
is confirmed; do not lead with a generic inability-to-confirm statement when
live log evidence can be collected.

For real-time inspection from a live temporary SSH session, use the helper:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>
```

The helper discovers the temporary SSH command from the triggering issue or pull
request, then follows the freshest `_diag/pages` log. The runner uploads chunks from
`_diag/blocks` to GitHub. Do not print environment files, tokens, or private keys while
inspecting the runner.

## Mac SSH access

The Mac private key stays at `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`. Its public key is
stored in the repository Actions secret `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY`. The issue
commented by the workflow contains a directly usable command such as:

```sh
ssh -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

The command works only while the corresponding Actions job is running.

## Connecting to a live OpenCode worker

Use the repository helper to discover the worker host and port from the broker
or issue comment. It uses the persistent local key `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub
```

For an interactive shell, reuse the host and port printed by the helper and
use the same key:

```sh
ssh -tt -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
  -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb \
  -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

Do not substitute the generated runner key under `sshworker/outputs/keys/`; it
can produce a misleading `Permission denied (publickey)` result. Temporary
worker SSH access ends when the Actions job and session are cleaned up. Never
print secrets while inspecting a worker.

Fan out sub-agents and have sub-agents tackle each one individually so that the game is utterly perfect. Have a separate sub-agent check each item visually to ensure it looks triple A. That separate sub-agent should be a really harsh critic, and if it doesn't look triple A, keep iterating until it does.

Don't stop until each sub-agent is utterly wowed with the quality when compared with the actual Call of Duty game. It should literally compare them side by side blind and say which one looks better. Do this in ThreeJS. Continue iterating until it's utterly perfect. Fan out sub-agents and ultracode.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })

+function spawnSparks(pos, color = 0xffffff, count = 10, speed = 4, size = 0.055) {
+  const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
+  const velocities = []
+  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
+    positions[i * 3] = pos.x
+    positions[i * 3 + 1] = pos.y
+    positions[i * 3 + 2] = pos.z
+    const a = rnd(0, TAU)
+    const up = rnd(0.2, 1)
+    velocities.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * rnd(0.4, 1) * speed, up * speed, Math.sin(a) * rnd(0.4, 1) * speed))
+  }
+  const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
+  geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
+  const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
+    color,
+    size,
+    map: world.textures.particle,
+    transparent: true,
+    opacity: 1,
+    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
+    depthWrite: false,
+    sizeAttenuation: true,
+  })
+  const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
+  points.frustumCulled = false
+  scene.add(points)
+  GAME.effects.push({
+    object: points,
+    life: 0,
+    maxLife: rnd(0.45, 0.8),
+    update(dt) {
+      this.life += dt
+      const arr = geo.attributes.position.array
+      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
+        const v = velocities[i]
+        v.y -= 9 * dt
+        arr[i * 3] += v.x * dt
+        arr[i * 3 + 1] += v.y * dt
+        arr[i * 3 + 2] += v.z * dt
+      }
+      geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true
+      mat.opacity = clamp(1 - this.life / this.maxLife, 0, 1)
+      return this.life < this.maxLife
+    },
+  })
+}
+
+function spawnRing(pos, color, startScale, endScale, duration, opacity = 0.5) {
+  const group = new THREE.Group()
+  group.position.copy(pos)
+  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
+    new THREE.RingGeometry(0.92, 1.0, 48),
+    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide })
+  )
+  mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
+  group.add(mesh)
+  scene.add(group)
+  GAME.effects.push({
+    object: group,
+    life: 0,
+    maxLife: duration,
+    startScale,
+    endScale,
+    opacity,
+    update(dt) {
+      this.life += dt
+      const p = clamp(this.life / this.maxLife, 0, 1)
+      const s = lerp(this.startScale, this.endScale, easeOut(p))
+      group.scale.set(s, s, s)
+      mesh.material.opacity = this.opacity * (1 - p)
+      return this.life < this.maxLife
+    },
+  })
+}
+
+function spawnMist(pos, color = 0x8eb5b6, scale = 1.6, duration = 1.1) {
+  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
+    map: world.textures.fog,
+    color,
+    transparent: true,
+    opacity: 0.28,
+    depthWrite: false,
+    blending: THREE.NormalBlending,
+    rotation: rnd(0, TAU),
+  }))
+  sprite.position.copy(pos)
+  sprite.scale.set(scale, scale * 0.55, 1)
+  scene.add(sprite)
+  GAME.effects.push({
+    object: sprite,
+    life: 0,
+    maxLife: duration,
+    update(dt) {
+      this.life += dt
+      const p = clamp(this.life / this.maxLife, 0, 1)
+      const s = scale * (1 + p * 1.6)
+      sprite.scale.set(s, s * 0.55, 1)
+      sprite.position.y += dt * 0.28
+      sprite.material.opacity = 0.3 * (1 - p)
+      sprite.material.rotation += dt * 0.25
+      return this.life < this.maxLife
+    },
+  })
+}
+
+function spawnSlash(pos, facing, color = 0x8fe6da, heavy = false) {
+  const group = new THREE.Group()
+  group.position.copy(pos)
+  group.position.y = heavy ? 0.7 : 1.05
+  group.rotation.y = facing - Math.PI / 2
+  const arc = new THREE.Mesh(
+    new THREE.RingGeometry(heavy ? 0.5 : 0.55, heavy ? 1.9 : 1.5, 28, 1, heavy ? -1.15 : -0.8, heavy ? 2.3 : 1.6),
+    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
+      color,
+      transparent: true,
+      opacity: heavy ? 0.55 : 0.42,
+      blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
+      depthWrite: false,
+      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
+    })
+  )
+  arc.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
+  group.add(arc)
+  const flash = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
+    map: world.textures.glow,
+    color,
+    transparent: true,
+    opacity: 0.35,
+    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
+    depthWrite: false,
+  }))
+  flash.position.set(0, 0.05, 0)
+  flash.scale.set(heavy ? 2.2 : 1.4, heavy ? 2.2 : 1.4, 1)
+  group.add(flash)
+  scene.add(group)
+  GAME.effects.push({
+    object: group,
+    life: 0,
+    maxLife: heavy ? 0.42 : 0.3,
+    update(dt) {
+      this.life += dt
+      const p = clamp(this.life / this.maxLife, 0, 1)
+      group.rotation.z += dt * (heavy ? 1.2 : 2.2)
+      const s = 1 + easeOut(p) * (heavy ? 0.65 : 0.35)
+      group.scale.set(s, s, s)
+      arc.material.opacity = (heavy ? 0.55 : 0.42) * (1 - p)
+      flash.material.opacity = 0.3 * (1 - p)
+      return this.life < this.maxLife
+    },
+  })
+}
+
+function spawnSoulBurst(pos, color = 0x74e0d4, count = 24) {
+  spawnSparks(pos, color, count, 3.4, 0.07)
+  spawnRing(pos.clone().setY(0.06), color, 0.2, 2.4, 0.8, 0.35)
+}
+
+function spawnProjectile(origin, target, damage) {
+  const group = new THREE.Group()
+  group.position.copy(origin)
+  const core = new THREE.Mesh(
+    new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.12, 8, 6),
+    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x7fdcff })
+  )
+  group.add(core)
+  const glow = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
+    map: world.textures.glow,
+    color: 0x76d7ff,
+    transparent: true,
+    blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
+    depthWrite: false,
+    opacity: 0.8,
+  }))
+  glow.scale.set(0.8, 0.8, 1)
+  group.add(glow)
+  scene.add(group)
+  const dir = target.clone().sub(origin).normalize()
+  GAME.projectiles.push({
+    group,
+    vel: dir.multiplyScalar(8.5),
+    life: 0,
+    damage,
+  })
+}
+
+function updateEffects(dt) {
+  for (let i = GAME.effects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
+    const fx = GAME.effects[i]
+    const alive = fx.update(dt)
+    if (!alive) {
+      scene.remove(fx.object)
+      GAME.effects.splice(i, 1)
+    }
+  }
+}

function returnToTitle() {
  document.exitPointerLock?.()
  GAME.state = 'title'
  GAME.phase = 'idle'
  GAME.slowmo = 0
  GAME.shake = 0
  GAME.titleTime = 0
  clearEntities()
  hideAllScreens()
  showScreen(ui.title)
  ui.hud.classList.add('is-hidden')
  ui.touch.classList.add('is-hidden')
  ui.bossBar.classList.add('is-hidden')
  ui.crosshair.style.opacity = ''
  resetProgression()
  player.group.position.set(0, 0, 16)
  player.group.rotation.set(0, Math.PI, 0)
  avatar.rig.rotation.set(0, 0, 0)
  avatar.rig.position.set(0, 0, 0)
  setSoundLabels()
}

function dodge() {
  if (GAME.state !== 'playing' || player.roll) return
  if (player.stamina < 28) return
  const input = getMoveDirection()
  let dir = input.lengthSq() > 0.01 ? input : new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(player.facing), 0, Math.cos(player.facing))
  dir.normalize()
  player.facing = Math.atan2(dir.x, dir.z)
  player.targetFacing = player.facing
  player.group.rotation.y = player.facing
  player.roll = { t: 0, duration: 0.52, dir, iframes: 0.36, speed: 10.5 }
  player.stamina -= 28
  player.regenDelay = 0.8
  player.invuln = Math.max(player.invuln, 0.36)
  audio.noise(0.24, 300, 0.07, 0, 1.1, 'lowpass', 100)
  spawnMist(player.group.position.clone().setY(0.5), 0x6b9b9a, 1.4, 0.65)
  updateHUD()
}

function useFlask() {
  if (GAME.state !== 'playing') return
  if (player.flasks <= 0) return
  if (player.hp >= player.maxHp - 0.5) {
    showToast('i-flask', 'You are already whole')
    return
  }
  player.flasks -= 1
  const healed = Math.min(52, player.maxHp - player.hp)
  player.hp += healed

  spawnRing(player.group.position.clone().setY(0.06), 0x8ee3b0, 0.3, 2.3, 0.7, 0.4)
  audio.flask()
  updateHUD()
}

+    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy)
+    const max = 42
+    const k = len > max ? max / len : 1
+    const ox = dx * k
+    const oy = dy * k

+    joystick.y = oy / max

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D dark-fantasy looting-and-crafting game in Three.js, with reasonable assumptions made without asking clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- 3D game, dark fantasy theme, looting and crafting.
- Complete and playable now; no clarifying questions.
- Note assumptions briefly when finished.

## Decisions
- Built a third-person action RPG titled **Gloamfall** using Three.js + Vite.
- Core loop: 3 combat waves then a boss (“The Bone Warden”), with loot drops, chests, shrine healing, crafting, equipment upgrades, soul levels, and victory/death/retry screens.
- Procedural world/assets only (canvas textures, procedural models/VFX/audio), bundled fonts; no external runtime assets.
- Desktop controls: WASD, mouse look, LMB light attack, RMB heavy, Space dodge, Q flask, E interact/gather, Tab/I satchel, Esc pause.
- Added mobile touch controls (joystick, look drag, attack/dodge/flask/use/satchel buttons).
- UI uses dark-gold gothic styling, HUD, minimap, wave/boss bars, loot toasts, damage numbers, inventory/forge overlay, title/pause/death/victory screens.
- Added procedural WebAudio ambience/SFX.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created project scaffold, HTML UI, full CSS, Three.js world, player/enemy/boss models, combat/AI, waves, loot, crafting, audio, and responsive touch controls.
- Installed dependencies and built successfully with `npm run build`.
- Started production server in tmux session `gloam` on `http://localhost:3000`.
- Installed Playwright Chromium and captured `screenshots/title.png` and `screenshots/game.png`.
- Fixed one runtime error (`e.flashMats is not iterable`) by changing `setEnemyFlash(e, e.flash)` to `setEnemyFlash(e.rig, e.flash)` in `updateEnemy`.
- Title screenshot looks stylistically good; gameplay screenshot exposed visual problems.

### Active
- Visual polish iteration: gameplay scene is far too dark, player cloak is oversized/floating, and player silhouette dominates the camera.
- Intended next edits: brighten exposure/lighting/ground texture, reduce fog, brighten player materials, add player rim light, fix cloak positioning/scale, increase camera distance/shoulder offset.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Apply planned visual fixes:
   - `renderer.toneMappingExposure` to ~1.3.
   - Reduce scene fog density from `0.027` to ~`0.021`.
   - Increase hemisphere/directional/fill lighting; add ambient light.
   - Brighten ground texture base RGB and ground/stone material colors.
   - Brighten player materials (`darkCloth`, `leather`, `innerCloth`) and add a subtle rim/back light.
   - In `src/entities.js`, move player cloaks down and shrink: cloak position around `(0, 0.08, -0.22)`, height ~1.32; cloak2 around `(0, -0.06, -0.2)`.
   - Increase camera distance (~6.4), shoulder offset (~0.65).
2. Rebuild (`npm run build`) or let Vite watch rebuild, then reload/screenshot gameplay.
3. Test combat, waves, loot pickup, satchel/forge crafting, death/retry, boss, and victory via Playwright.
4. Check mobile layout/touch UI at narrow viewport.
